outlet: Lopez Solid Waste Disposal District, 'Dump Levy 101: What You Need to Know!' (Sarah Reeves)
notes: District explainer posted about five days before 2026-10-08: proposed rate about $0.091 per $1,000, 'the same as last year's levy rate'; $45.50 on $500,000; levy usually one third or less of operating expenses; $105,000 in 2014 (about 40%), 19% in 2023, $210,000 since 2024; disposal charges up 30% since 2023, diesel up 47% in a year, new Interlocal Agreement leasing fees; if it fails, the district operates on about 67% of needed funding.
